corrections.text: The article says the repository page "lists 16.9k stars and 505 forks" without a date. These are point-in-time figures read from the GitHub page on October 6, 2026, and will change.

The article says a continued fork "would need separate branding." The project's notice phrases this as a request: "The Pico CSS name and logo are not covered by the MIT license. Please give your fork its own name, so users don't confuse it with the original."
